heading: In June, comparable branch revenue increased by +3.4M, but the result was accompanied by lower quantity sold across the same branch group.
paragraphs: Comparable branch revenue increased by +3.4M in June.
Transactions (bills) increased by +240.1K across the comparable branches.
Quantity sold declined by -249.9K, so revenue growth did not come with higher item sales.
Basket Size declined by -0.10, which means transactions rose while each transaction contained fewer items on average.
Compare the +240.1K change in transactions with the -249.9K change in quantity across CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021.
Review the -0.10 change in Basket Size by branch and category to see where item sales weakened within the comparable group.
Monitor whether revenue change stays positive at +3.4M if quantity remains at -249.9K and Basket Size remains at -0.10.
